shortDescription.default: Client-only SPFx web part for employee onboarding, transfer and offboarding in Microsoft 365, backed by Microsoft Graph and SharePoint lists.

longDescription.default: User Provisioning Center runs employee onboarding, transfers and offboarding out of Microsoft 365 with no Azure Functions and no custom backend. Every operation is a delegated Microsoft Graph call made from the browser under the signed-in operator's own permissions; job state, tasks, templates and the audit trail live in SharePoint lists. Ships as a SharePoint web part, a Teams tab and a Teams personal app.
